# The Standard

> > Hong Kong's leading English-language newspaper covering finance, property, world affairs, sports, innovation, and local news with focus on regional and global economic developments.

The Standard provides comprehensive coverage of Hong Kong's role in China's economic planning, regional financial markets, geopolitical tensions affecting oil prices, technological innovation from companies like OpenAI, and major sporting events. The publication serves as a bridge between Hong Kong, mainland China, and international business communities.

## Key Topics

- Hong Kong economic policy
- China's 15th Five-Year Plan
- Oil prices and Strait of Hormuz
- Iran geopolitical tensions
- Hang Seng Index
- Hong Kong property market
- Market integrity and insider trading
- OpenAI and ChatGPT innovation
- MTR Corporation
- US inflation and consumer prices
- Japan GDP
- Olympic sports
- Kai Tak Stadium
- Aramco energy sector
- AI in filmmaking
